verdict.rationale: Segment's HTTP Tracking API (api.segment.io) is documented and confirmed live with write-key authentication (returns structured 400 on invalid key), and a server-side Node SDK exists for programmatic server-to-server sends; the Segment Spec formalizes the payload format. However, explicit documentation of delivery guarantees (retry policies, at-least-once semantics, batching/queueing behavior) is not present in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: documented delivery-guarantee/retry semantics for the ingestion API, and independent verification of server-side batching reliability.
